answer: The dodol kitchen smells of coconut milk and palm sugar, the great wok over a low fire. Proof of dodol-maker via sticky rice cake tally — a cake the dodol-maker stirs only after 33 cakes set firm without one sticking to the pan, each stirred by the dodol-maker herself. thread stirs the thickening paste with the long paddle and keeps it moving. onyx tests a spoonful on the plate and watches it hold its shape. orchard pours the set dodol out and cuts it into diamonds. Thirty-three cakes must set firm without one cake sticking to the pan, and the next still clings where the stirring stopped.
